day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadka Soddonka ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto, idinkoo maanta isugu yimid inaynu ereyga Ilaah ku xoojino quluubteenna.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Naftaydu waxay u harraadsan tahay Ilaaha nool.
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirkan: qof marti ah oo si taxaddar leh u dooranaya kursiga ugu fiican ee miiska, isagoo rajaynaya in dadka kale ay arkaan muhiimaddiisa. Waa sawir bini'aadamka aad ugu dhow—rabitaanka ah in la inoo arko, in la inoo qaddariyo, iyo in la inoo aqoonsado meel sare. Laakiin Ciise, isagoo ka hadlaya guriga Farisiga, wuxuu inoo soo bandhigayaa sawir kale. Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in boqortooyada Ilaah ay tahay meel ka duwan. 'Qof kasta oo is-sarraysiiya waa la hoosaysiin doonaa, kii is-hoosaysiiyana waa la sarraysiin doonaa.'

Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil aan marnaba u baahnayn inuu u tartamo meel sare. Waxaan ognahay inuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines', shirkaddaas yar ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin waxa Ben ka dhigayay mid gaar ah ma ahayn aqoontiisa sare ee xisaabta ama sida uu ugu dhex jiray AWS environments; waxay ahayd fudaydka qalbigiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil si dabiici ah u ogaa in qiimihiisu uusan ku xirnayn meesha uu miiska ka fadhiyo, ee uu ku xirnaa jacaylka uu bixinayay.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in noloshu ay tahay Masiix, dhimashaduna ay tahay guul. 'Waxaan rabaa inaan baxo oo aan Masiixa la joogo, waayo taasi waa ka fiican tahay.' Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa meeshaas sare, meesha uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo ka xor ah xanuun kasta iyo culeys kasta. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo ka dhergay jacaylka Ilaah. Waxaan xusuustaa riyadii aad la wadaagteen, markii Ben uu ku yiri: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…' Wuxuu gudbay imtixaankii nolosha si kaamil ah. Wuxuu hadda joogaa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo nabad qaba.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida kursiga uu qof kasta u tartamayo, Ben wuxuu doorbiday inuu noqdo mid fudud, mid jecel, oo mid naftiisa u hura dadka kale.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si muuqata. Igu soo dhowow qalbigaaga, oo ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhoweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa oo uu siiyo nabad weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska saaran, inuu Rabbigu siiyo qalbi dagan, rajo, iyo xoog ay maalin kasta ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Sida kastaba ha ahaatee, ha ahaato is-yeel-yeel ama run, Masiixa waa la wacdiyayaa, waanan ku farxayaa. Oo weliba waan sii farxi doonaa, waayo, waan ogahay in tani ay ii noqon doonto badbaado, iyada oo loo marayo ducadiinna iyo taageerada Ruuxa Ciise Masiix. Rajadayda iyo filashadayda aadka u weyn waa inaanan marnaba ceeboobin, laakiin inaan geesinimo buuxda ku muujiyo Masiixa jidhkayga, ha ahaato nolol ama geeri. Waayo, aniga noloshu waa Masiix, dhimashaduna waa faa'iido. Haddii aan sii noolaado, taasi waa midho dhal u ah shaqadayda. Mana aqaano mid aan dooran doono. Waxaan ku dhex jiraa labadaas. Waxaan rabaa inaan ka tago noloshan oo aan la joogo Masiix, waayo taasi waa ka fiican tahay. Hase yeeshee, inaan jidhka ku sii jiro ayaa idiin dhaanta. Tanina waan ogahay kalsooni, inaan sii joogi doono oo aan sii wadi doono adeegga dhammaantiin, si aad horumar iyo farxad ugu yeelataan iimaanka, si faanka idin kaga dhex jira Ciise Masiix uu u bato markaan mar kale idiin yimaado.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Naftaydu waxay u harraadsan tahay Ilaaha nool. Sida deeradu ay ugu harraadsan tahay biyaha qulqulaya, sidaas oo kale ayay naftaydu ugu harraadsan tahay adiga, Ilaahow. R. Naftaydu waxay u harraadsan tahay Ilaaha nool. Naftaydu waxay u harraadsan tahay Ilaah, Ilaaha nool. Goorma ayaan tegi doonaa oo aan arki doonaa wejiga Ilaah? R. Naftaydu waxay u harraadsan tahay Ilaaha nool. Waxaan la socday dadkii badnaa, waxaana u hoggaaminayay guriga Ilaah. Iyadoo ay jiraan qaylo farxad iyo mahadnaq ah, oo dadku ay iid dhigayaan. R. Naftaydu waxay u harraadsan tahay Ilaaha nool.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Maalin sabti ah ayuu Ciise u tegey inuu wax la cuno mid ka mid ah Farisiiyiinta ugu waaweyn, dadkiina way u fiirsanayeen. Wuxuu u sheegay masaal kuwa la casuumay, isagoo arkaya sida ay u dooranayaan kuraasta sharafta leh ee miiska: “Marka qof kuu casuumo aroos, ha ku fadhiisan kursiga sharafta leh. Waxaa laga yaabaa in qof kaaga sharaf badan la casuumay, kii casuumay labadiinnana uu kuu yimaado oo uu ku yiraahdo, ‘Kursigan u bannee ninkan,’ markaasna aad ceeb ku tagto kursiga ugu hooseeya. Hase yeeshee, markii laguu casuumo, tag oo fadhiiso kursiga ugu hooseeya, si markii uu kii ku casuumay kuu yimaado uu ku yiraahdo, ‘Saaxiibow, kor ugu kac meel sare.’ Markaas ayaad sharaf ku dhex yeelan doontaa kuwa miiska kula fadhiya. Waayo, qof kasta oo is-sarraysiiya waa la hoosaysiin doonaa, kii is-hoosaysiiyana waa la sarraysiin doonaa.”

day: Saturday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
